title: Detection of Leishmania spp. in Blood and DNA
author: Rania M. H. Baleela
license_note: Confirmed via CrossRef DOI metadata: dx.doi.org/10.17504/protocols.io.jm2ck8e
materials: The following were added to the ready PCR mix (Maxime™ PCR Premix Kit (i-Taq), (Taq™ DNA polymerase 2.5U, dNTPs 2.5 mM, reaction buffer 10X and gel loading buffer 1X): 1 μl of each primer (10 pmol/ μl), 16 μl ddH₂O 2μl (50 ng/ μl) of DNA PCR amplification was performed using a G-storm DNA thermo-cycler with an initial denaturation step of 5 minutes at 94°C, then 35 cycles of 94°C for 30 seconds, 57°C for 30 seconds (annealing), and 72°C for 1minutes (extension). All PCR products were visualized on 1.5% agarose gel electrophoresis stained with 0.5mg/ml ethidium bromide at 83V in 0.5X TBE (0.045 Tris-borate, 1mM EDTA).

steps.title: Collect and store blood and tissue samples
steps.instruction: Draw blood from the medial metatarsal vein; place a portion into EDTA‑containing tubes for microscopy and spread the remaining blood onto Whatman filter paper No. 1, air‑dry, then store the dried papers in airtight plastic bags. Preserve any collected bat or rat tissue samples in 70 % ethanol.

steps.title: Prepare and stain thin blood films
steps.instruction: Place a drop of blood on one end of a microscope slide, use a spreader slide at a 45° angle to spread the blood along the slide, and let the film air‑dry. Fix the dried film with 70 % methanol, air‑dry again, then immerse the slide in Giemsa stain prepared at a 1 ml stain : 9 ml H₂O ratio for 10 minutes. Wash the slide, air‑dry, and examine for parasites using 10×, 40×, and 100× oil immersion lenses.

steps.title: Lyse cells and digest proteins
steps.instruction: Add 500 µl of STE lysis buffer (10 mM Tris/HCl pH 7.5, 0.3 mM EDTA pH 7.5, 100 mM NaCl) to each blood‑spot sample and homogenize gently. Add 5 µl proteinase K and 30 µl of 10 % SDS, then incubate at 65 °C in a water bath for 1 hour, vortexing vigorously every 10 minutes.

steps.title: Extract DNA with phenol‑chloroform
steps.instruction: Add 500 µl ice‑cold phenol‑chloroform‑isoamyl alcohol (25 : 24 : 1) to the lysate, vortex well, and centrifuge for 15 minutes at 7,000 rpm. Transfer the supernatant to a fresh tube, add an equal volume of chloroform‑isoamyl alcohol (24 : 1), mix by inversion, and centrifuge for 3 minutes at 7,000 rpm. Transfer the resulting supernatant to a new tube.

steps.title: Precipitate, wash and resuspend DNA
steps.instruction: To the supernatant add 55 µl of 6 M NaCl and 1 ml cold absolute ethanol, mix, and store overnight at –20 °C to precipitate DNA. Centrifuge, discard supernatant, wash the pellet with 70 % ethanol, air‑dry, and resuspend the DNA pellet in 50 µl sterile ddH₂O.

steps.title: Set up PCR with extracted DNA
steps.instruction: Use 50 ng of the purified genomic DNA in a 20 µl ddH₂O reaction mixture as template for amplification of Leishmania genomic DNA.
